title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Steel Thanes

entities.name: The Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: The seven powerful Phyrexians who dominate the faction associated with black mana, each secretly seeking to become Father of Machines.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A thane who holds the tenuous position of Praetor, ruling through a network of spies and information.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: An undead once-Moriok thane who holds the Vault of Whispers and binds others with eldritch contracts.

entities.name: Azax-Azog
entities.description: A demon thane who rules through cruelty and fear.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: A thane who hates all flesh and has replaced his own with metal, attached to a great golem.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: A massive oil-slick thane building a new layer between the Furnace Layer and Mirrodin's core.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: A compleated vampire thane, assassin and former leader in the Bleak Coven.

entities.name: Thrissik
entities.description: A thane who believes Phyrexia must give birth to its own destroyer and seeks to recognize it.

entities.name: Father of Machines
entities.description: The title of supreme leader of Phyrexia that each thane believes he, she or it deserves.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Praetor of the Furnace Layer whose Phyrexianized monstrosities fight Azax-Azog's minions.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A past ruler of Mirrodin during whose day Mephidross creatures were already Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: The swampy region of Mirrodin, epicenter of the rise of New Phyrexia at Ish-Sah.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: Geth's seat, at Ish-Sah.

entities.name: Ish-Sah
entities.description: The epicenter of the Mephidross where the rise of New Phyrexia began.

entities.name: Bleak Coven
entities.description: A mercenary organization Vraan once led and which he approximates among the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Contract of Geth
entities.description: Eldritch metal tablets binding signers by will to Geth.

entities.name: Kraynox's Orrery
entities.description: An object of nested half-spheres representing Kraynox's theories of how Phyrexia should look.

entities.name: Crypt of Keepsakes
entities.description: Vraan's hidden library of victims' heads.

entities.name: Wailing Cairns
entities.description: Weeping skull cairns Azax-Azog's followers build in his realm.

entities.name: Astral Coffers
entities.description: Polygons containing Sheoldred's thoughts.

events.summary: The rise of New Phyrexia begins at Ish-Sah, the epicenter of the Mephidross.
events.quote: The rise of New Phyrexia began at Ish-Sah, the epicenter of the Mephidross.

events.summary: The seven thanes claim power during the war with the plane's inhabitants and carve out territories.
events.quote: Having claimed power during the war with the plane's inhabitants, the thanes have managed to carve out territories

events.summary: Geth is rewarded with a new body for his complicity in the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: for his complicity in their invasion he was rewarded with a new body.

events.summary: Azax-Azog carves out a realm from the Mephidross into the Oxidda Chain and battles Urabrask's creatures.
events.quote: Azog's minions constantly battle Urabrask's Phyrexianized monstrosities that now reside in the mountains

events.summary: Kraynox begins weaving a new layer between the Furnace Layer and the core.
events.quote: began his great project to weave a new layer between the mycosynth pillars

events.summary: Vraan survives the war as a compleated vampire and offers his Bleak Coven's services to the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Thane Vraan survived the war with Mirrodin's natives as a compleated vampire.
